sentences.en: The international space station is an amazing feat of engineering.
sentences.zh: 国际空间站是一项令人惊叹的工程成就。

sentences.en: It's amazing how loud my classmates are in English class.
sentences.zh: 英语课上同学们的声音真大，这真是让人惊讶。

sentences.en: It is amazing; you should have won the prize.
sentences.zh: 真是令人难以置信；你应该会赢得那个奖项。
